topic: A day at the strawberry farm
passage: Last Saturday, my family and I visited a strawberry farm outside the city. We left home at eight in the morning and arrived after an hour on the bus. Although the weather looked cloudy, we decided to go anyway because my daughter had waited for this trip for two weeks. At the farm, a young worker welcomed us and showed us how to pick the fruit. She explained that we should choose the red ones and leave the green ones on the plants. We walked around the fields with small baskets and picked strawberries one by one. My son laughed when he found a very big one, and he showed it to everyone. At noon, we rested under a large tree and tasted the fresh fruit. The strawberries tasted sweet, and my wife said they were much better than the ones in the supermarket. Before we left, we bought two boxes of strawberries and thanked the worker for her help. On the way home, my daughter fell asleep in my arms. It was a simple trip, but it gave us a happy memory that we will remember for a long time.

vocab.note: -ed 读 /t/，直接连到 around；注意 walked 的 t 几乎不爆破
-ed 读 /t/；picked 的 t 滑进 strawberries 的 s
-ed 读 /t/，别读成 thank-ed；th 是舌尖音
-ed 读 /t/；looked cloudy 连读时 t 很轻，容易漏听

coach_rationale: 继续本周重点——过去式 -ed 听辨（上次听写 gave/showed/felt 系统性丢分的老问题）。这篇草莓园文章过去式动词密度高，3 个听写关键句里埋了 looked、walked、picked、thanked 这些 -ed 读 /t/ 的靶子；同时叠加 EnglishPod 精听笔记 5–7 周的短语动词连读（walked around、picked strawberries）。跟读保持 A2 简单句，不跟读 B1 文本。
